description: C# bindings for SDL3 (Simple DirectMedia Layer 3) with the SDL3 native libraries included for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. Window management, input, gamepads, audio, rendering, GPU and the rest of the SDL3 API from .NET, with friendly string overloads and no NuGet dependencies.
